title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
script:
Zero dollars in profit. Most companies are getting no financial payoff from AI.
Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Sløk revealed this in his recent analysis.
Massive corporate investments and widespread hype failed to show up on balance sheets.
Tech companies drive the current adoption wave while traditional industries see no returns.
Sløk notes that AI productivity gains are not yet manifesting in broader corporate earnings.
Is your business seeing actual revenue from your AI tools?
